title: Vomiting and diarrhea
content: Vomiting combined with diarrhea over 24 hours can indicate dietary indiscretion, infection, parasites, or in rare cases something more serious. If it persists beyond a day, contains blood, or your pet is lethargic, book a Medical Consultation.

title: Limping or reluctance to walk
content: Limping can be caused by a minor sprain, a thorn or cut in the paw, or joint issues. Check the paw pads for visible injury. If limping persists more than a day or the leg looks swollen, book a Medical Consultation.

title: Excessive scratching or itching
content: Persistent scratching often points to fleas, allergies, or skin infections. Check the coat for fleas or flea dirt. An Anti-flea Collar may help for mild cases; for ongoing itching book a Medical Consultation.

title: Loss of appetite
content: Not eating for more than 24 hours is a reason for concern, especially in cats. It can indicate dental pain, stress, or an underlying illness. Book a same-day Medical Consultation if appetite loss continues past a day.

title: Bad breath or dental issues
content: Persistent bad breath can indicate dental disease or tartar buildup. Regular Grooming Sessions and periodic dental checks during a Medical Consultation help prevent this.
